purpose: Use an extreme example or a small minimum to show degree.
keywords: Plain form / noun + くらい / ぐらい
I was so happy I could not sleep.
I remember at least the name.
The wind is so strong I cannot stay standing.
formation: Plain form / noun + くらい / ぐらい
restrictions: Can emphasize how intense something is or how modest a minimum is.
mistake: Context distinguishes this use from approximate quantities.
